cpu_affinity.reason: Hybrid CPU and observed unrelated background load. Pin single-thread API samples to the same performance core; retain normal priority. Multi-thread samples use all logical processors. User processes are not modified.

data.contract: Rotated independent-process variant order; workload order reverses on alternate process rounds. First calls excluded from mean/median summaries, retained in raw rows. All accepted baseline output hashes enforced on every result. Unique removes byte-identical payload duplicates before API, so its speedup cannot be due to batch duplicate sharing. No input/filesystem cold-cache claim. Process peak working set includes loading, verification and retained results; not heap payload. Optional prewarm runs are archived separately and were declared before the cohort. Instrumented timing is diagnostic only and must not be used as performance evidence.

data.condition: All pending full workspace, native15-job, public/metadata/cache and actual Wasm quality gates must pass for the pinned source/binaries before promotion.
data.rationale: A narrow representation change with four favorable distinct1thread paired process means and consistent peak working-set reductions is reasonable to retain. CPU benefit is modest; sixteen-thread repeated throughput is mixed and slightly worse by mean.
data.predeclared_strong_signal: at least1.05x distinct1thread mean and all process pairs favorable; smaller/mixed results explicitly allowed review
data.source_diff_note: Six representation-related files vs c50; comparison to W10 build snapshot also contains only one removed trailing blank line in test-only ast/src/inline_temps/legacy_clone.rs, already matching c50.
cautions: Four paired processes are the independent experimental units; repeats within a process are correlated. No statistical significance or universal speedup claimed.

Unique16 repeat mean is0.99122x,3/4 process pairs slower, worst pair4.78percent more elapsed; first-call mean1.02874x and all4favorable. Preserve the possible small multithread regression, do not label it proved noise.
Large mean1.07544x is strongly influenced by retained W10 repeat5.56847s; median1.01522x. Do not present7.54percent as a stable large-script gain.
UI worst repeat29.084ms vs22.652ms and unique16 worst823.677ms vs766.942ms are retained. Small/correlated samples do not establish a tail-latency distribution; no uniform p95/p99 improvement claim.
RSS is process peak working set including loading, verification and retained outputs, not Rust heap allocation bytes or per-call peaks.
These native measurements establish no Wasm speed benefit and do not meet the3x–5x user target. No inferred59percent runtime gain from slot-size reduction.

model_contract: C is the summed capacity of uniquely visited Block statement Vecs in each per-function snapshot. The two stages are separate and must not be added.
Native x86_64 sizes only. These corpus-wide sums span different scripts/functions and times; they are not simultaneous peak heap or retained process memory.
Box payload count is live nodes at the snapshot, not cumulative Box::new/clone/rebuild requests. Allocator headers/rounding, Vec headers, and unchanged nested payload allocations are excluded.
Same-function structured blocks are visited once by borrowed address; child Function bodies are never entered. All census calls completed with zero budget/lock refusals.

Incoming CFG parameter Vecs, edge-argument Vecs, and closure-capture Vecs are reported separately. RcLocal metadata, the external upvalues_in Vec, and child-function parameter/body storage are not counted here.
INPUT is before SSA construction; POST_SSA is immediately after destruction and before structuring. NumericFor is zero at these stages and may be introduced later.
Every timing field is excluded. This instrumented run may overlap a candidate build; counts are the sole evidence used.
Completed profile runner checked emitted sources against the unchanged locked manifest. Raw 1GB phase rows were not reparsed for this analysis.
data.decision: Proceed with the already-authorized four-loop boxing quality/performance pilot. The targets occupy only 0.54% of input statements and 2.21% after SSA, while reducing every Statement capacity slot. The model removes about 58.6% of this specific native storage at either stage; it predicts neither whole-engine memory nor runtime speedup. Actual clone/allocation overhead and full quality gates decide promotion.
Do not implement transferable reduction certificates as the next broad optimization; prioritize the ordinary four-box Statement experiment.
data.basis: Executed operation exposure only. No measured speedup, redundancy proof, per-node correspondence, or fixed-point assumption.
limits: RValue dispatch and typed kernel axes overlap; never add them as unique AST node visits. Probe subsets also overlap totals.
161666 dispatch entries beyond direct roots include recursion, repeated mode calls and clone probes; they are not a proved removable-work count.
Same-consumer batches identify calls only. Non-idempotent synthesis can require later reductions; no occurrence identity or fixed-point status was tracked.
Pre/Post callbacks overlap by occurrence and stop early. Accepted search includes edge sites; reduction batches count statement substitutions only.
Effect implementation entries include statement wrappers. Purity/intrinsic/walker axes can overlap. Fact operand counters count actual callbacks/duplicates, not all internal LocalRw nodes.
Aggregate ratios can hide narrow deep-expression workloads. This finding rejects a broad corpus-first priority, not all possible specialized future reductions.
No diagnostic duration or process wall time is used; this run overlapped builds. Counts do not price operations or prove the boxed Statement pilot faster.
The whole SSA inline phase, not just reduction, was roughly10.2percent of an earlier heavy diagnostic total; this is context only, not an ordinary timing ceiling proof.
counterexamples_to_blanket_skipping: value-mode (not a) and (not a) changes on the second reduction
condition-mode numeric negation and literal string concatenation require another reduction to become true
Boolean identity rules may deliberately reduce a child again
Origins and float bits are not covered by ordinary structural PartialEq
data.next_action: Run the already prepared four-box Statement prototype through ordinary quality and timing gates. Do not spend another source wave on reduction-proof arenas from these counts. Larger search/fact counts are observations, not authorization for a new cache.
